data.narrative:
Netrasemi is a Series A chip design company operating within the Chips & Semiconductors sector. The broader comp universe includes 11 same-sector peers (3 public: ALAB, NVDA, AMD; 8 private including SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent). However, the peer-median method is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables—only 1 same-stage and 1 adjacent-stage peer were identified, falling short of the 3-datapoint minimum needed for reliable triangulation.

The sparsity of true peer companies at Netrasemi's stage and valuation tier prevents deployment of standard peer multiples analysis. The broader sector comp set of 11 same-sector peers cannot be reliably applied without introducing significant methodological noise. Public comparables (NVDA, AMD, ALAB) operate at vastly different scales and revenue stages, making EV/revenue or EV/EBITDA multiples non-transferable to a Series A private company pre-revenue or minimal-revenue stage.

This analysis cannot support a specific valuation range given the data constraints. Substantive valuation work would require either (1) expansion of the private comp set to include 2–3 additional Series A or late-seed semiconductor design companies with disclosed post-money valuations, or (2) shift to bottom-up methods (DCF, option-pool adjusted SAFE model) anchored to the company's technical roadmap and addressable market. The founders (Jyothis Indirabhai, Deepa Geetha, Sreejith Varma) and prior $13M raise are noted, but without comparable transaction data, valuation remains indeterminate.
